answer: The glacier test I would run is Sismo proof of group membership: a proof of belonging to a group, name hidden, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that a proof of belonging to a group, name hidden cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the haven of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the plume of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
